Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 16

“Of the unreal there is no being; of the real there is no ceasing to be. The truth of both has been seen by those who perceive reality.”

A compressed, almost mathematical verse. Krishna is drawing a line between what changes and what does not, and crediting the distinction to direct seers rather than to clever argument.
